purpose: Actual outcome of the crit-arm kill-split repair against the prediction registered before it was written.
registration_shortfall: The per-family ceilings counted only rows with an unreachable CRIT ARM. The patch also fixed the exactly-on-the-line roll being dropped from both buckets, and -- visible on the anchor row -- restored secondary-effect branches on the newly reachable survive arm. Those are additional clearance sources the ceiling did not model, so three per-family lines were exceeded even though the aggregate held. The ceiling should have been registered for the bundle, or the two fixes measured separately.
headline: The repair is correct and fixes a real engine fidelity gap -- 285 archive rows and 4 fresh rows now land in-support -- but it does NOT move the certification gate. Unattributed is unchanged at 29 on the fresh sample (~4,833 per 10,000 games) and falls only 883 -> 855 on the archive. The gate is the capped-heal matcher artifact, which this patch does not touch, exactly as the diagnosis predicted.
open_items: tests/test_search_depth_tactics.py::test_trap_moves_win_at_most_the_crit_lottery [perish-clock] now returns p_win_upper 9.5361328125e-07 against an asserted strict 0.0.
